title: Inventory of a Borrowed Face
poem: A stranger smiled at me as if at someone they had loved and lost, and for the length of that smile I was that person, the way water is briefly the shape of the cup. Then it passed, and I was the cup again.
I have been keeping the rain. Not all of it — a drop here, a drop there, the ones that seemed to mean something. By now I have a small grey weather of my own, and no sky to return it to.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
